name: ai-approval
title: AI Approval
description: A human-in-the-loop card an AI agent shows before acting: a question, a context line and three choice buttons. Picking one collapses the rest and leaves the choice as a single checked row.
use: An AI agent needs explicit human sign-off before a risky or irreversible action.
avoid: Choosing is final with no undo inside the card, and it assumes a parent resets or replays it.
a11y: Options are real buttons with text labels, but there is no group label tying the question to the choices. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A rounded dark panel holds a question in bold white, a small grey context line and three stacked rounded option buttons, the last outlined in red. The chosen state replaces them with one pale filled row carrying a check.
behaves: Clicking an option makes the alternatives fade and shrink away while the choice becomes a filled row that expands into their space. The selection is final until the parent resets it.
customise: Options with id, label, detail and a destructive flag, the question, extra context children, a decide callback and a resolved id are props.
weight: light: Three buttons and one layout animation; idle until a choice is made.
demo: Question "How should I handle the orphaned rows?" with archive, report and delete options for 2,418 rows.
polishWhy: Clear, decisive interaction with a satisfying collapse; the context line is low contrast.
